jobs.name: nightly-audit
jobs.description: Full internal-link and asset audit of the site source.

jobs.name: sitemap-generate
jobs.description: Regenerate sitemap.xml from the page tree and commit if changed.

jobs.name: health-check
jobs.description: Curl the live site and assert every public page returns 200.

jobs.name: ping-search
jobs.description: Ping Google and Bing with the current sitemap URL.

jobs.name: worker-verify
jobs.description: Verify the Cloudflare Worker's health endpoint responds. The Worker also runs its own */15 health cron natively.
